svg.title: Calyx AI architecture
svg.desc: The platform-sync service pulls calls from the call-tracking platforms into Go services for ingestion, consumption, enrichment, compliance, scoring and Ask AI, which use Kafka and Redis and store data in ClickHouse and PostgreSQL. A TypeScript API serves a Next.js dashboard. Write-back requests go from the API to platform sync, which calls the platforms. Platform sync uses Deepgram for transcription; scoring and Ask AI call OpenAI. Both providers sit behind feature flags.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, 'SF Mono', SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'Liberation Mono', monospace

svg.text: CALYX AI ON DOCKER COMPOSE, LINUX SERVER
